ticket.subject: Sign in with Google bounces me back
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Since yesterday's update, when I click 'Sign in with Google' I am sent back to the login page without any error. Email and password still work, so I can get in that way for now.

Could you look at it this week?

Thanks,
Jonas

label_notes: access vs bug: it may be a defect, but the symptom is 'cannot sign in', and access beats bug; a workaround exists, so P3; 'this week' = medium.
